safety: Installed browsers, disposable profiles, owned loopback fixtures and deny proxies. No third-party code execution or installs, live sites, personal-profile changes, commits or pushes. Harmless downloads remained in owned temporary directories and were never opened.
clipboardVerification: Native permission, offscreen/background transport and copy-command readiness checked; execCommand writes intercepted into an isolated sink. Windows clipboard was neither read nor changed. Actual OS clipboard output remains unverified.
notificationVerification: Native create/getAll/clear in all browsers; callback clicks and lifecycle failures covered by unit fixtures. Desktop toast rendering/clicks and saveAs file chooser were not tested.
limits: HTTP(S) GET downloads only, 2 MiB response cap, 30-second fetch timeout, no redirects or overwrite mode.
Optional permissions are extension-wide, with exact grants and native document/connection validation per script.
Firefox ignores silent notifications; it does not implement that native option.
Accepted clipboard writes cannot be undone; already accepted native saves can finish after abrupt worker termination and are never replayed.
Offline fixtures do not establish full Violentmonkey compatibility or universal live-site ad blocking.
